test.create_query: CREATE TABLE icp_opt (l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_shipdate Date, l_tag Int32) ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = 'iceberg_compaction_opt_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/')
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO icp_opt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, 0 FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0 SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO icp_opt SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, 1 FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 100 = 1 SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
SELECT throwIf(countIf(content = 1) != 1) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'icp_opt'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(*)) FROM icp_opt) != (count(), sum(cityHash64(l_orderkey, l_partkey, toFloat64(l_quantity), toFloat64(l_extendedprice), l_shipdate, toInt32(0))))) FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0

SELECT throwIf(countIf(content = 1) != 0 OR sumIf(record_count, content = 0) != (SELECT count() FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0)) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'icp_opt'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(*)) FROM icp_opt) != (count(), sum(cityHash64(l_orderkey, l_partkey, toFloat64(l_quantity), toFloat64(l_extendedprice), l_shipdate, toInt32(0))))) FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_orderkey % 10 = 0 SETTINGS optimize_trivial_count_query = 0
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS icp_opt, icp_opt_run, icp_ref_run SYNC
